title: Here's what I actually spend...
transcript: How much do you spend on your own advertisements? Probably a lot less than people think, because I have, for the meta ad space, a very large organic following. We are nearly always constrained by capacity to deliver on our various offers as opposed to demand. We have a repeatable cycle where we finally build out a bit of extra capacity in our agency. We turn ads on, we spend like $5,000 on it, and immediately we're at capacity when we turn them off again. So, like, we rarely will spend more than, say, 10, 15 thousand dollars in a month. We could spend way more than that if we had the capacity to deliver, but we often don't. And we're very clear that we'd rather say no to business, or at least not yet, and maintain high service quality as opposed to just getting as many people in through the door as possible.
